entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-15
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Linux packaging: dotnet-host 11 conflicts with dotnet-sdk-10.0 over dnx files #55303
  • Windows arm64 NativeAOT cross-build (dotnet-aot) AoT CI leg persistently failing #55298
    11.0.1xx
  • Aot publish failed on macos arm64 with .NET 11 #55296
  • Cannot publish a project with top-level statements if an output directory is specified #55295
  • new issueSd #55294

Closed

  • [dotnet-watch] Remove workaround for https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/130823 #55307
  • Error when attempting to `apt-get install dotnet-sdk-10.0` on Pop!_OS 24.04 LTS #53834
  • Blazor WebAssembly SDK should default MetricsSupport, EventSourceSupport, and HttpActivityPropagationSupport to true #54821
  • Add --list-devices support for dotnet test #54378

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix internal auth #55305
    Servicing-consider
  • Ground AI architecture claims in sources #55304
    Area-AIEngineering
  • Add digest validation and use user cache directory in SDK container builds #55301
  • dotnet test: truncate large failing-host output in summary (#52297) #55300
  • Add `dotnet test --list-tests json` via SDK-side rendering #55299
  • [Draft] Support Microsoft.Build.Traversal projects in dotnet test (MTP) #55297
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55293
  • Install clang in codespace for NativeAOT builds #55291
  • Add testConfig.json that sets captureTrace=false #55290

Merged

  • Keep MSTest.Sdk in sync with MSTest framework to fix NativeAOT test discovery #55302
  • Update GenerateRuntimeConfigurationFiles task to generate Hot Reload runtime options #53715
  • Enable method-level parallelization for true unit test projects #55090

Updated

  • Do not report `CA2007` for pattern-based `await using` and `await foreach` #55036
  • CA1873: Fix log level comparison #54891
  • [Proposal] Analyzer test readability/performance improvements #54119
    Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
  • Make CA1860 work with abstract collections #50461
    Area-Infrastructure, Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
  • [Experiment] Agentic Triage Workflow #55244
  • Merging internal commits for release/9.0.1xx #55281
  • fix: normalize IntermediateOutputPath slashes in posix platforms #54536
    Area-Watch
  • Add location-gated AGENTS.md guidance for key src and test subtrees #55198
  • Add dotnet sdk add and dotnet sdk remove commands #54577
    Area-CLI
  • Enable NativeAOT CLI command handling by default (DOTNET_CLI_ENABLEAOT) #55144
    breaking-change, needs-breaking-change-doc-created, 11.0.1xx
  • Adopt MSBuild partial ProjectInstance evaluation in CLI hot paths #55271
  • Fix hostfxr resolution failure on musl when `HOSTFXR_PATH` is not set #55270
  • Add MAUI device deployment to dotnet test #55260
  • [Experiment] Create a .NET SDK Issue Monster #55243
  • Scope .editorconfig discovery to included files in dotnet format folder mode #55248
  • .NET Source-Build 9.0.119 July 2026 Updates #55275
    Servicing-consider
  • Add platform-native local container CLI support #55249
    breaking-change, Area-Containers
  • Batch WithSource project-file rewrites into a single pass #55269
  • Apply dotnet test zero-tests verdict at the whole-run level (microsoft/testfx#7457) #55167
  • [release/10.0.4xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55289
  • Use AnalysisMode=minimum in Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers and fix errors (perf rules) #54125
    Area-Infrastructure, Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
  • CA1860 should be reported for derived types as well (analyzer fix with performance improvements) #54124
    Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
  • Reduce allocations in EnumsShouldHaveZeroValueAnalyzer #54123
    Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
  • [Proposal] Use Span-based methods to split strings in analyzers #54121
    Area-Infrastructure, Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
  • Suppress advertising manifest messages unless verbosity is diagnostic #55276
